overview: Luke Sullivan is a shotoclone character with an emphasis on a strong midrange pressure and whiff punishing. Luke has most of the standard shoto tools you could want, but puts several unique spins on them to craft his own style. Where Ryu is defensive and neutral-oriented, and Ken is aggression and combo-utility oriented, Luke focuses on a strong midrange that transitions into excellent pressure once he's gotten in.

One notable thing about Luke compared to other shotos is his many advancing target combos that let him convert openings into effective punishes and pressure. Luke can use his great 2MP, 5MK and 2MK to push opponents back, or lunge forward for punishes with 5LP, 5MP and 5HP. Complimenting this is his signature Sand Blast fireball, an exceptionally formidable tool for both neutral and pressure. Its extremely high speed allows Luke to use it as an extended poke or blockstring ender while still having good advantage on block at most ranges. If he chooses to spend meter on OD or Drive Rush, then Luke is also capable of dealing monstrous damage and carrying you very deep into the corner.

Once the opponent is in the corner or low on Drive, Luke is extremely formidable at locking the opponent down. Easy throw loops, a fast and safe overhead, a Level 3 Super that gives him oki, along with many ways to be plus or even fully reset pressure. Many of Luke's normals lunge him forward, which synergizes with Drive Rush to create hard-to-escape pressure sequences and surprise whiff punish opportunities. On defense Luke excels at well, with his 2LP being a 4f jab with a great hitbox. He has a great DP with Rising Uppercut and a fantastic anti-air in 2HP.

Perhaps the only things Luke could be considered to struggle with is his approaches, as he doesn't have as many ways to effectively skip neutral and force RPS in neutral the same way other top tiers like Ken and Juri can. He also has a rather poor sweep, but he can make up for this by using 5HP to punish a sweep on block instead of sweeping back. All in all, Luke is a character with few meaningful weaknesses, and can perform well at all levels of play. While his 5LP is on the slower side, this is because it moves him forward for better punishes and pressure and thus exists as a tradeoff rather than a weakness. Sand Blast similarly does not travel fullscreen outside of the OD version, but this is another tradeoff for its powerful speed and frame advantage. None of these differences create meaningful weaknesses in Luke, allowing him to craft a strong and reliable gameplan. If you want a shoto with more of a focus on pressure and playing out the midrange, you should hit the streets with Luke.

pick.title: Well Rounded
pick.text: A remixed yet still generalist shoto-esque kit that is never truly out of options

pick.title: Extremely Safe
pick.text: Pressure that is hard to challenge with a 2MP that is plus

pick.title: Disciplined Neutral
pick.text: Many safe and forward moving normals that allow for potent whiff punishes and a hitscan fireball that keeps them locked down

pick.title: Everything in One Combo
pick.text: His Perfect Flash Knuckle combos give his best corner carry, damage, and oki when you can route into them

avoid.title: Combo Focused Special Moves
avoid.text: Most special moves don't have much utility in pressure or neutral

avoid.title: Low Impact
avoid.text: Having below average damage even with meter

avoid.title: Straightforward
avoid.text: A general lack of silly gimmicks to rely on, slightly ironic considering how much of a goober Luke is

moves.name: Eraser
moves.notes: Extremely fast super that works well in juggles; in the corner, gives Luke an auto-timed strike/throw mixup; on hit, the animation is not invincible until the very end (can be hit by delayed projectiles like Kimberly Spraycan or JP Amnesia orbs); Full Dmg distribution: 300x3,200x6,700

moves.name: HP Flash Knuckle
moves.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state (can only juggle into canceled SA3); worse KD advantage vs. airborne opponents (+31 when juggled after 5LP~MP~HP); can cancel into SA3 on reaction if opponent attempts a Drive Impact; pulls back hurtbox on frames 5-15

moves.name: HP Flash Knuckle (hold)
moves.notes: 1f extra recovery on hit/block; active frames 3-4 can nullify normal 1-hit projectiles; cancelable into SA3 on reaction if opponent attempts a Drive Impact; pulls back hurtbox on frames 5-25; leaves opponent close on block for a 2LK~2LP hitconfirm or a 1f microwalk into throw (slightly longer if opponent walks back)

moves.name: HP Flash Knuckle (perfect)
moves.notes: Hold HP 18-20f for perfect version; active frames 3-4 can nullify normal 1-hit projectiles; 1f more recovery on hit/block; cancelable into SA3 on reaction if opponent attempts a Drive Impact; pulls back hurtbox on frames 5-25; leaves opponent close on block for a 2LK~2LP hitconfirm or a 1f microwalk into throw (slightly longer if opponent walks back)

moves.name: LP Flash Knuckle
moves.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state; no head hurtbox on frames 6-17 for improved anti-air; the final 2 recovery frames are cancelable on Hit into specials/Supers (enables a corner juggle into 623LP or SA2)

moves.name: LP Flash Knuckle (hold)
moves.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state; active frames 3-4 can nullify normal 1-hit projectiles; canceling to SA3 will cause juggle to whiff; 1f more recovery on hit/block; no head hurtbox on frames 6-29 for improved anti-air

moves.name: LP Flash Knuckle (perfect)
moves.notes: Hold LP 18-20f for perfect version; launches opponent high into a limited juggle state; active frames 3-4 can nullify normal 1-hit projectiles; canceling to SA3 will cause juggle to whiff; 1f more recovery on hit/block; no head hurtbox on frames 6-29 for improved anti-air

moves.name: MP Flash Knuckle
moves.notes: Leaves opponent standing on hit, very slightly out of throw range; knocks airborne opponents far away into a limited juggle state

moves.name: MP Flash Knuckle (hold)
moves.notes: Wall Bounce on hit for a limited juggle state; active frames 3-4 can nullify normal 1-hit projectiles; higher KD Adv when farther from wall (opponent may bounce over Luke's head if too close to the wall); SA3 cancel only juggles properly in corner; 1f more recovery on hit/block; cannot combo naturally when canceled from 2HP

moves.name: MP Flash Knuckle (perfect)
moves.notes: Hold MP 18-20f for perfect version; Wall Bounce on hit for a limited juggle state; active frames 3-4 can nullify normal 1-hit projectiles; higher KD Adv. when farther from wall (opponent may bounce over Luke's head if too close to the wall); SA3 cancel only juggles properly in corner; 1f more recovery on hit/block; perfect timing allows natural combo from 2HP cancel

moves.name: OD Flash Knuckle
moves.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state; active frames 3-4 can nullify normal 1-hit projectiles; listed recovery is for blocked/whiffed version (on hit, automatically transitions to 2nd hit); 1st hit is cancelable into PP follow-up for 1 extra Drive bar on hit only; can juggle directly into any Super (canceling into Super will cause SA3 to whiff; SA2 will whiff on final cancelable frame)

moves.name: DDT
moves.notes: Costs 1 extra Drive bar on 214PP 1st hit only (cannot activate on block or when armor absorbed); leaves Luke close enough to walk in for a strike/throw mixup; counts as a separate hit from 214PP for damage scaling; in juggles, only connects on opponents low to the ground and will not come out if opponent is juggled higher

moves.name: Pale Rider
moves.notes: Luke runs forward; active frames occur upon reaching the opponent or on frame 27 (whichever occurs first) but invincibility is not extended when far from opponent; has juggle potential; on block, bounces away with a fixed recovery period (whiff recovery is 26f slower); cinematic time regenerates ~2 Drive bars for Luke; takes opponent to Memphis

moves.name: Pale Rider (CA)
moves.notes: Luke runs forward; active frames occur upon reaching the opponent or on frame 27 (whichever occurs first) but invincibility is not extended when far from opponent; has juggle potential; on block, bounces away with a fixed recovery period (whiff recovery is 26f slower); cinematic time regenerates ~2.3 Drive bars for Luke; available at 25% HP or below; does not take opponent to Memphis

moves.name: Vulcan Blast
moves.notes: 5 hit Super projectile, first 4 hits travel 65% screen, final hit goes fullscreen; higher KD Adv. when farther from wall; extends a projectile-vulnerable hurtbox during startup frames 2-5 (more difficult to use as an anti-fireball tool)

moves.name: Sand Blast
moves.notes: 1-hit projectile, travels ~91% screen length; [] refers to projectile active time

moves.name: Avenger
moves.notes: Follow-up P or K can be input on frames 12-32; Luke is in a counter-hit state for entire duration

moves.name: Avenger
moves.notes: Armor does not apply to follow-up attacks; follow-up P or K can be input up to frame 32; follow-up can start immediately after armor hit freeze without waiting for any additional Avenger startup frames to occur; Luke is in a Punish Counter state for entire duration

moves.name: Impaler
moves.notes: First 2 active frames can only hit airborne opponents; Luke is in a crouching state for entire recovery duration; puts opponent into limited juggle state

moves.name: No Chaser
moves.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state; very late connect to juggle into 623LP/MP, SA1, or SA2 (otherwise, can only cancel into SA2 or SA3); midscreen, later active frames canceled into SA2 will whiff

moves.name: Impaler
moves.notes: First 2 active frames can only hit airborne opponents; 3rd active frame hits grounded and gives the best KD Advantage (cannot hit meaty to allow a follow-up juggle); Luke is in a crouching state for entire recovery duration; puts opponents into limited juggle state; 5f extra recovery on whiff

moves.name: No Chaser
moves.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state; very late connect to juggle into 623LP/MP, SA1, or SA2 (otherwise, can only cancel into SA3)

moves.name: Sand Blast
moves.notes: 1-hit projectile, travels ~48% screen length; [] refers to projectile active time

moves.name: Sand Blast
moves.notes: 1-hit projectile, travels ~66% screen length; [] refers to projectile active time

moves.name: Sand Blast
moves.notes: 2-hit OD projectile, full screen length; puts opponent into limited juggle state; can follow up with PP for 1 extra Drive bar; extends a projectile invuln hurtbox on frames 19-36 (more vulnerable to ranged jumps and anti-projectile moves)

moves.name: Fatal Shot
moves.notes: 1-hit OD projectile; costs 1 extra Drive bar; () refers to scaled damage after 236PP connects; causes a wallsplat on hit (can combo near the corner, or whiff 236K~P to safely gain ground); extends a projectile invuln hurtbox on frames 10-32 (more vulnerable to ranged jumps and anti-projectile moves)

moves.name: Trench Breaker
moves.notes: Has juggle potential; has a fixed 26f recovery on block regardless of which active frame connects (always -9 oB even when meaty)

moves.name: Crouching Heavy Punch
moves.notes: Forces stand on hit; only the first active frame is cancelable; good anti-air hitbox but cannot hit cross-ups

moves.name: Crouching Light Kick
moves.notes: Chains into 2LP/2LK

moves.name: Crouching Light Punch
moves.notes: Chains into 2LP/2LK; Luke's only 4f normal, useful in 3-hit light confirms; DR cancel is delayed until after 1st recovery frame; topmost hurtbox on frames 1-5 is vulnerable only to aerial strikes (preventing its use as an anti-air)

moves.name: Crouching Medium Kick
moves.notes: Moves Luke forward, greatly increasing its range despite the stubby-looking animation; Range: 1.482 (1st active frame: 1.44); DR cancel is delayed until after active frames; has an extended hurtbox on whiff until the end of recovery

moves.name: Crouching Medium Punch
moves.notes: 3f extra recovery on whiff; great pressure tool with high reward on counter-hit or when canceled to Drive Rush; has an extended hurtbox on whiff until the end of recovery; topmost hurtbox on frames 1-7 is vulnerable only to aerial strikes (preventing its use as an anti-air)

moves.name: Outlaw Kick
moves.notes: Whiffs on crouching opponents at farther ranges unless they extend a vertical hurtbox; puts airborne opponents into spinning limited juggle state; no head hurtbox during active frames, making it a useful anti-air; after DR~4HK on block, Luke is at the edge of throw range and can also threaten with 2LK~2LP to punish walk back, or 2LP to beat reversal 4f normals; extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles

moves.name: Suppressor
moves.notes: Pulls back hurtbox frames 5-12 for an auto-shimmy tool (also very strong when used out of Drive Rush)

moves.name: Scrapper
moves.notes: Side switches; no throw oki after back throwing opponent into corner, but can threaten with meaty strikes; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Back Taunt
moves.notes: "Hadooken!"

moves.name: Standing Heavy Kick
moves.notes: 8-15f Low Crush (feet are strike invincible); puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; Punish Counter launches opponent high into a limited juggle state; can be spaced for significantly better advantage; extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles; first 2 active frames have shorter range (makes it easier to space properly); causes camera shake effect on block when connecting with final active frame (easier to tell when Luke has advantage)

moves.name: Standing Heavy Punch
moves.notes: Good whiff punish tool due to its long range and cancelability; extends a vertical collision box to reduce the risk of whiffing under opponent mid-juggle

moves.name: Standing Light Kick
moves.notes: DR cancel is delayed until after 1st recovery frame

moves.name: Standing Light Punch
moves.notes: Long range for a cancelable light normal, good whiff punish tool; 3f extra recovery on whiff; greatly extends hurtbox for 3f before active, making it susceptible to counterpokes; special/DR cancel is delayed until after active frames

moves.name: Triple Impact
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage when starting combo with 5LP

moves.name: Triple Impact 2
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage when starting combo with 5LP; puts opponent into limited juggle state; special/DR cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame

moves.name: Standing Medium Kick
moves.notes: Good neutral poke; 3f extra recovery on whiff; lifts up leg hurtbox on frames 4-11, making it strong vs. low attacks

moves.name: Standing Medium Punch
moves.notes: Good whiff punish tool when buffered into Target Combo or Super

moves.name: Snapback Combo
moves.notes: Useful buffer from 5MP in neutral that can end with Super or the full Target Combo sequence; Super cancel is delayed until after 4th recovery frame

moves.name: Snapback Combo 2
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage

moves.name: Snapback Combo 3
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage; full sequence builds significant Drive gauge; knockdown grants a perfect meaty Dash + 5HK (+1 on Block even vs. midscreen Back Rise)

moves.name: Neutral Taunt
moves.notes: "Come on!"

moves.name: Rising Uppercut
moves.notes: Reduced damage and higher juggle start/increase/limit on active frames 2-10; cannot hit cross-up; does not juggle into SA3 despite being cancelable

moves.name: Rising Uppercut
moves.notes: Reduced damage and higher juggle start/increase/limit on active frames 3-10; cannot hit cross-up; does not juggle into SA3 despite being cancelable; much higher juggle limit than other versions of Rising Uppercut (useful in corner juggles)

moves.name: Rising Uppercut
moves.notes: Reduced damage and higher juggle start/increase/limit on active frames 3-10; cannot hit cross-up; does not juggle into SA3 despite being cancelable

moves.name: Rising Uppercut
moves.notes: Reduced damage 3rd active frame of 1st hit (will only do 1 hit for 600 damage on later active frames); cannot hit cross-up; can cancel into PP follow-up on hit for 1 Drive bar; 2nd hit whiffs vs. crouch block (reduced chip damage, worse advantage)

moves.name: Slam Dunk
moves.notes: Follow-up on hit only for 1 additional Drive bar; can whiff against high juggled opponent; counts as a separate hit for damage scaling

moves.name: Brutal Spike
moves.notes: 4f extra recovery on whiff; 5f gap on block into TC follow-up

moves.name: Battering Ram (Block)
moves.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; see Drive Reversal.

moves.name: Battering Ram (Recovery)
moves.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see Drive Reversal.

moves.name: Double Impact
moves.notes: 5f gap on block between hits; causes a staggered tailspin when performed after Punish Counter 6HP (allows a cancel into fully charged Flash Knuckle of any strength or a +28 DR Cancel); this Punish Counter version forces stand and does not incur any extra damage scaling

moves.name: Rawhide
moves.notes: Causes spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; has some juggle potential

moves.name: Forward Taunt
moves.notes: "Yeah! Let's let it fly!"

moves.name: Muzzle Flash
moves.notes: See Drive Impact. Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

moves.name: Aerial Flash Knuckle
moves.notes: Can be input during forward/neutral jump (or back jump when canceled from j.MP); 7f extra landing recovery on whiff if input during the first 32 jump frames; Luke is in a crouching state from 4th landing recovery frame onward; improved frame advantage when done lower to the ground, and spaced out at farther ranges; can only be up to -1 on block if not precisely spaced; can partially charge the attack and release early for better juggle advantage after 214[LP]

moves.name: Aerial Flash Knuckle
moves.notes: Can be input during forward/neutral jump (or back jump when canceled from j.MP); the final 12 recovery frames are in a crouching state; puts the opponent into a limited juggle state; kara-canceling the startup with j.214P~PP can affect Luke's trajectory and frame advantage

moves.name: Aerial Flash Knuckle (hold)
moves.notes: Can be input during forward/neutral jump (or back jump when canceled from j.MP); the final 12 recovery frames are in a crouching state; puts the opponent into a limited juggle state (can follow-up with 623LP if opponent is juggled at max height)

moves.name: Jumping Heavy Kick
moves.notes: Better horizontal range than j.HP for long-range jumps; lower body projectile invuln 10-19f except around attack hitbox, and 10-24f for lowest part of foot hurtbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Heavy Punch
moves.notes: Spike knockdown on counter-hit/Punish Counter vs. airborne opponents; good close range jump-in and neutral jump throw bait tool; lower body projectile invuln 9-23f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Light Kick
moves.notes: Cross-up

moves.name: Jumping Medium Kick
moves.notes: Cross-up; lower body projectile invuln 7-20f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Medium Punch
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; has some juggle potential; can significantly delay the cancel into j.214P, allowing unique combos after pf.214[LP]; lower body projectile invuln 9-22f (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Sweeper
moves.notes: Has access to corner throw loop, requires walking with manual timing (4f timing leniency to beat reversal 4f buttons); a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Drive Parry
moves.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: Drive Rush Cancel
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: Parry Drive Rush
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.817 (min/throw), 2.499 (min/block), 3.461 (max/final DR frame)

patches.summary: Alex Release. Balance changes for all characters.
notes: 5HP recovery on block reduced 23 → 22; Block Advantage -6 → -5; Perfect Parry Advantage -24 → -23
Does not affect blockstring gaps when canceled into specials/DR
Double Impact (6HP~HP) 2nd hit results in a staggered tailspin (Forces Stand) when the 1st hit connects as a Punish Counter
Advantage on Punish Counter: +2 (+37 on the cancel frame, allowing a cancel into any fully charged Flash Knuckle); also +28 after DR Cancel
Punish Counter version does not incur the usual 2-hit damage scaling when comboed into
LP Flash Knuckle (214LP) recovery reduced 31 → 27; KD Advantage increased +32 → +36; blockstun increased 16 → 18; Block Advantage -18 → -12; Perfect Parry Advantage -32 → -28
Reduced horizontal knockback on grounded opponents; the final 2 recovery frames on Hit are special/Super cancelable (allows corner juggle into 623LP or SA2)
Reduced knockdown advantage on airborne opponents (to prevent unintended combo routes alongside the other changes)
Held HP Flash Knuckle (214[HP]) decreased pushback on block for both regular/perfect versions
On close range hit, Luke is in range for 2LK~2LP confirm or a 1-frame microwalk throw (longer microwalk if the opponent walks back)

patches.summary: Sagat Release. Minor bug fixes and adjustments (mostly related to Tiger Shot interactions).
notes: OD Avenger (236KK) armored head hurtbox shifted downward (to prevent interference with High Tiger Shot)

patches.summary: Elena Release. Balance changes for all characters.
notes: More consistent in light chains, and cannot be interrupted on block by 4f normals
Low Crush hurtbox on frames 8-15 raised higher to avoid more crouching moves
KD Advantage increased HKD +28 → KD +40 (along with universal HKD removal)
Punish Counter Advantage increased HKD +44 → HKD +47
After DR~4HK, Luke is in Throw range (but opponent can walk out)
Also close enough to threaten 2LK~2LP against back walk or 2LP to beat 4f jabs
Can now Dash + meaty 5HK (+1 oB even vs. midscreen Back Rise
Entire sequence now builds ~1/2 Drive bar on its own (not including passive Regen)
Greatly reduced the projectile-invuln arm hurtbox that starts 1f before active and lasts until 2nd active frame
Significantly harder for opponents to counterpoke the startup at mid-range, or use OD uppercut-type moves to beat it on reaction
Cancel window into Fatal Shot (~PP) extended by 5 frames
~PP hitconfirm window at close range increased 11f → 16f
Much more effective in corner juggles where Luke previously had no meterless options
Startup on fully held version reduced 30 → 29
Allow combos from 2HP without Perfect timing
Non-Perfect combos will still receive extra damage scaling
No longer has lower recovery when absorbed by armor (214[MP] will always be fully punished even when absorbed late)
This change was made because it's no longer possible for a failed 2HP > pf.214[MP] combo to be punished with a DI crumple
Input requirements adjusted to prevent accidentally activating the attack after crossing under an airborne opponent
Now always safe (and even plus with meaty timing)

Upper body hurtbox expands 5 frames later (14f → 19f), making it better in projectile wars

Juggle follow-ups are possible near the corner; from midscreen, can whiff 236K~P to become +4 at close range
Increased hitstop when the base of the attack connects
Increased the buffer window at the end of recovery
2nd hit expands the hitbox upward when the 1st hit connects to ensure juggle consistency
Reduced pushback on hit (still outside throw range, but can throw with a very short microwalk)
Because it is now -4 against Burnout, characters may struggle to punish at certain spacings, creating a new pressure loop
Increased the buffer window at the end of recovery
2nd hit no longer adds an extra hit of damage scaling
Travels much farther forward on cinematic hit (improved corner carry)
Reduced horizontal knockback on airborne opponents for more consistent juggles into the full animation

patches.summary: Terry Release. Minor balance changes and bug fixes.
notes: Reduced pushback on hit and block
Can now pressure with blocked DR~2MP into 2LK~2LP to frame trap and punish back walk
Retains more Drive Rush momentum for combo consistency
Fixed issue where the proximity guard hitbox did not match the full attack hitbox range

patches.summary: M. Bison Release. Minor balance changes and bug fixes.
notes: Input is now accepted during the chain cancel window

patches.summary: Akuma Release. Balance changes for all characters.
notes: 2MK extends a hurtbox on whiff until end of recovery
5HP Hit Advantage -1 → +1, expanded collision box upward for juggle consistency
5HK active 6 → 7, recovery 17 → 16 (1f better advantage when spaced at max range)
Camera shake added when blocked at max range (easy to identify when Luke is plus on block)
2HP applies an extra 5% damage scaling to next attack when comboed into
Anti-air hurtbox shifted forward and reduced downward, upper body hurtbox expanded
Outlaw Kick (4HK) Punish Counter Advantage +19 → +17 and more pushback
Much weaker optimal punish routes; no more DR~4HK into DR~4HK
Fatal Shot (236PP~PP) damage 700 → 1000, Super Art gain 400 → 1000, Punish Counter Drive damage 2000 → 7000
Charged MP Flash Knuckle (214[MP]) recovery vs. armor 27 → 23 on the non-Perfect version
Attempting 2HP > pf.214[MP] is now safe vs. Drive Impact if combo is dropped
Charged HP Flash Knuckle (214[HP]) KD advantage +63 → +64 on both Perfect and non-Perfect versions
No Chaser (236K/KK~P) active 7 → 10, recovery 19 → 16, hitconfirm window (SA3) increased to 27f on close-range connect
SA3/CA invincibility no longer extends beyond 1-13f from long range (much worse vs. projectiles)

notes: Whiff recovery increased 14 → 17 with a larger hurtbox
When performed near the jump apex, has a shorter trajectory and landing recovery on whiff increased 13 → 20
Larger feet hurtbox on frame 16 until end of recovery
Wider projectile-vulnerable hurtbox on startup frames 1-5
